_doc: Optimal ARM big-core CPU config for real device (Snapdragon/Dimensity/Exynos).
WHY these flags:
threads: 4           — Targets the 4 big (Cortex-A7x/X-series) cores. Using all 8
cores adds little-core overhead that hurts latency.
precision: low       — Enables FP16 NEON FMLA throughout MatMul and attention.
Halves memory bandwidth for weights/activations on ARMv8.2+.
memory: low          — Uses MNN's compact allocator; shares buffers aggressively
across ops to minimise DRAM pressure and TLB misses.
power: high          — Requests performance governor hint from MNN runtime;
scheduler prefers big cores over LITTLE efficiency cores.
quant_qkv: 11        — Bitmask: 3 (K=INT8 + V=FP8) | 8 (flash attention).
Compresses KV cache ~4× and enables fused softmax kernel.
prefer_decode: true  — Sets DYNAMIC_QUANT_OPTIONS bit 3; selects decode-optimised
INT8 GEMM kernels tuned for single-token throughput.
use_mmap: true       — Memory-maps .mnn weight files instead of malloc+read;
the OS pages in weights on demand, saving ~50% peak RSS.
DYNAMIC_QUANT_OPTIONS: 1  — Enables per-tensor dynamic INT8 quantization for
general conv/matmul; combined with prefer_decode
the runtime applies value (1%8)+8 = 9 for decode kernels.
CPU_LITTLECORE_DECREASE_RATE: 100  — Tells MNN that LITTLE cores have 0% capacity
relative to big cores → all work goes to big cores.
CPU_SME2_INSTRUCTIONS: 1  — Enables ARM SME2 codepath on cores that support it
(Cortex-X4/X925). No-op on older SoCs.
KVCACHE_SIZE_LIMIT: -1    — Unlimited in-memory KV cache (no disk spill).
